name: Radio catalogue + player
integration: Load radio-player.css in the document head.
Insert radio-player.html or an empty element with data-fuct-radio.
Fetch catalogue.json and explicitly call mountRadioCatalogue once. index.html supplies the active standalone Pages test.
Keep this mount alive outside route replacement if playback must continue across SPA navigation; destroy it only when the player is being removed. Full document navigation unloads audio.
input: Pass catalogue.tracks in its recorded newest-first display order. Optional initialIndex selects a deterministic paused mix; omitted initialIndex selects a random paused mix, matching the source.
api: select(index) switches and plays; selecting the current mix toggles play/pause. select(index,false) changes without autoplay.
getState() returns selected index, track, playing, expanded, progress percentage and error.
destroy() removes owned DOM/listeners, pauses/releases audio and preserves an existing data-fuct-radio marker. Remount uses a new call.
createRadioController(audio,tracks,onChange,options) is the independent native transport layer used by the component and tests.
preserved_behavior: 28 music choices with artwork, titles, exact genre values and source-reversed catalogue ordering.
Four catalogue columns at1280px and above; one column below1280px.
Selecting a different mix starts it; selecting the same mix or player control toggles playback. Only one audio element is used.
Expanded/compact player, artwork/title/date and playback progress. Collapse preserves audio playback.
Source title marquee, visual playback icons and genre clipping.
adaptations: React/Remix provider and components ported to manual native-DOM mount without external JavaScript dependencies; originals retained as evidence.
Feature CSS scoped beneath data-fuct-radio; minimal original reset/utility rules and Fira Mono font loading included.
Audio URL outer whitespace trimmed and interior spaces percent-encoded, with exact original values retained in catalogue.json.
Native ended event and finite duration guard replace exact100percent detection; single event subscriptions and cleanup replace accumulated source listeners.
Play Promise rejection and obsolete track-request rejection are handled; a small live status reports playback failure.
Native button names/keyboard behavior, focus styling and reduced-motion fallback added.
preload=metadata requests metadata rather than the default automatic preload. No local/session storage added.
Play icon and blur-circle layers share the artwork button as their positioning container, removing mismatched responsive overlay widths.

Player is bottom-docked at every width, full-width when expanded and71px wide at bottom-right when collapsed. Height includes the complete progress bar and bottom safe-area inset; catalogue clearance is reserved.
not_in_source: No seeking/scrubbing, volume slider, next/previous, shuffle control, automatic next mix, playlist persistence or Media Session controls. Progress is display-only.
hosting: Mount in a host document served over HTTP(S), not file://. Supply an appropriate Content Security Policy for the recorded CDN/font domains if the host uses one.
assets: Original media stay on the source CDNs. Availability and headers checked, with no complete long music-file download. Some WAV files exceed1GB. Physical mobile playback/backgrounding and complete-track duration not validated.
source_references: source/*.original.js are exact compiled slices/route module; their imported alias bindings are not standalone modules. source-analysis.json records the enclosing bundles, offsets, hashes and dependencies. Original catalogue HTML and original feature CSS are preserved.
